Name: Extra Nodes in Mines and Cavern
Author: BeardedRascal
Description:
This mod adds 9 extra vanilla nodes and 2 stumps in [i]The Mines[/i] and the [i]Skull Cavern[/i]. By default they'll unlock after meeting their requirements, detailed below.
Spawning conditions are entirely configurable, and you can remove the unlock requirements by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] or editing the config.json file.
If you don't want a particular node to appear, just set its spawn frequency to "0".
[i](Default balance is still WIP)[/i]

[b]Coal Nodes[/b] :
- Unlocked after repairing the bridge to the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Quarry]Quarry[/url].
- Chance to spawn on any floor in [i]The Mines[/i] and the [i]Skull Cavern[/i].

[b]Bone Nodes[/b] :
- Unlocked after repairing the bridge to the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Ginger_Island#Dig_Site]Dig Site[/url] on Ginger Island.
- Chance to spawn from floor 71 in "Qi's danger in the deep" version of [i]The Mines[/i].

[b]Clay Nodes[/b] :
- Unlocked after repairing the bridge to the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Ginger_Island#Dig_Site]Dig Site[/url] on Ginger Island.
- Chance to spawn from floor 1 to floor 39 in[i] The Mines[/i].

[b]Cinder Shard Nodes[/b] :
- Unlocked after reaching the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Forge]Forge[/url] in the Volcano Dungeon.
- Chance to spawn from floor 50 in the [i]Skull Cavern[/i].

[b]Omni Geode Nodes[/b] :
- Unlocked after reaching the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Forge]Forge[/url] in the Volcano Dungeon.
- Chance to spawn from floor 81 in [i]The Mines[/i] and from floor 1 in the [i]Skull Cavern[/i].

[b]Iridium Nodes[/b] :
- Unlocked after finding [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Iridium_Ore]iridium ore[/url] for the first time.
- Chance to spawn from floor 101 in [i]The Mines[/i].

[b]Geode Nodes[/b] :
- Unlocked after reaching floor 40 in [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/The_Mines]The Mines[/url].
- Chance to spawn from floor 1 to floor 39 in [i]The Mines[/i].

[b]Frozen Geode Nodes[/b] :
- Unlocked after reaching floor 80 in [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/The_Mines]The Mines[/url].
- Chance to spawn from floor 41 to floor 79 in [i]The Mines[/i].

[b]Magma Nodes[/b] :
- Unlocked after reaching floor 120 in [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/The_Mines]The Mines[/url].
- Chance to spawn from floor 81 to floor 120 in [i]The Mines[/i].

[b]Stumps[/b] :
- Unlocked after reaching [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Foraging#Foraging_Skill]Foraging[/url] skill level 3.
- Chance to spawn from floor 1 to floor 120 in [i]The Mines[/i].

[b]Mossy Stumps[/b] :
- Unlocked after experiencing your first [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Weather#Green_Rain]Green Rain[/url].
- Chance to spawn from floor 1 to floor 120 in [i]The Mines[/i].

Requirements : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]Item Extensions Framework[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
This is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

[u]Installation / Usage :
[/u]
- Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]Item Extensions Framework[/url]
- Extract the content of this downloaded mod zip file into your [i]Mods[/i] folder
- Launch the game using SMAPI
- Edit the config.json file or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to configure the mod at your leisure
